snapshot.source: existing working tree; uncommitted changes included

scope.sdk: Registered adapters, delegated CalendarKit targets, and Vera.Live.fetch. The full 11684-row search index includes stubs and is not an implemented-function catalog.
scope.intents: Seven curated addresses, all bundled Celia candidate keys, all bundled summary keys, and the dynamic-registry contract. Device-dependent addresses require a device snapshot.
scope.status: supported means the stated functional scope exists in current source. unimplemented includes partial equivalents. android_platform_limitation applies only to literal OHOS routes or APIs, not inferred functional impossibility.
scope.planned: Every unimplemented applicable equivalent remains future work. No future package is marked implemented.
scope.verification: Source inventory and integrity only. No emulator, device, SDK execution, model request, or credential access.
scope.android_dispositions: All 554 registered SDK/calendar/curated intent runtime keys have explicit Android dispositions and P6 family assignments. Candidate mappings do not assert full equivalence or implementation.

ui.scope: The complete reference component contract is absent. Native primitives provide only the explicit subsets below.

graphics.scope: No generated graphics schema, renderer, or pointer-event contract exists.

sdk.scope: Exact reference bindings are absent. android-dispositions.json defines a concrete candidate, restriction, or target-specific unresolved contract for every registered SDK key.

calendar.scope: Calendar read and creation-form subsets do not implement this complete reference contract. Direct calendar writes are explicitly unavailable.

live.scope: Generated JavaScript cannot call a search/model host bridge or fetch live figures.

intent.scope: This literal OHOS bundle/module/ability route cannot execute through Alphy Android adapters. Functional equivalents require separate Android contracts.

intent_candidate.scope: Offline OHOS candidate only. No module, ability, live presence, or verified Android contract exists.

intent_summary.scope: Description metadata does not prove a callable target or a supported function.

intent_registry.scope: OHOS insight-intent enumeration and signing permissions are not Android contracts. Alphy has only its bounded native catalog.

workflow.scope: The complete reference workflow is absent; current Alphy generation uses a bounded JSON tool workflow.

ui_helper.scope: The exact std/ui helper export is absent. Generated JavaScript can perform local calculations within sandbox limits.

ui:Column.scope: column supports bounded vertical children. Reference style sets are absent.

ui:Row.scope: row currently renders vertically. Horizontal flow and reference style sets are absent.

ui:Text.scope: text supports a label and optional scalar binding. Reference text styles and exact text semantics are absent.

ui:Button.scope: button sends an action with null value. Reference numeric value, enabled prop, and style contract are absent.

ui:TextField.scope: input binds a string and submits it explicitly. Reference field props and event contract differ.

ui:Toggle.scope: toggle uses a Checkbox and boolean state. Reference style and enabled props are absent.

ui:Checkbox.scope: toggle provides a boolean Checkbox. Reference component and prop contract are absent.

ui:ListItem.scope: list renders typed records with an optional stable-ID action. Reference ListItem layout and payload contract are absent.

sdk:CameraKit.CameraManager.setTorchMode.scope: flashlight.set supports boolean on/off for one available camera. AUTO and ALWAYS_OPEN reference modes are absent.

sdk:SensorServiceKit.vibrator.vibrate.scope: vibration.play supports one shot of 1..2000 milliseconds. Reference patterns, modes, and lifecycle differ.

sdk:SensorServiceKit.vibrator.startVibra.scope: vibration.play supports one shot of 1..2000 milliseconds. Reference patterns, modes, and lifecycle differ.

calendar:CalendarKit.Calendar.getEvents.scope: calendar.read reads at most 50 instances in a selected calendar and a 31-day range. Reference filters, fields, and wire format differ.

calendar:CalendarKit.Calendar.queryEvent.scope: calendar.read reads at most 50 instances in a selected calendar and a 31-day range. Reference filters, fields, and wire format differ.

calendar:CalendarKit.CalendarManager.edi.scope: calendar.create opens ACTION_INSERT with title, times, and location. Saving and event IDs remain unverified.

intent:com.huawei.hmos.calendar/phone/Ma.scope: app.open with calendar launches an Android calendar selector. It does not execute the literal OHOS route.

intent:com.huawei.hmos.maps.app/entry/En.scope: The reference excludes this ignored intent from discovery. maps.open launches an Android geo search; visible results remain unverified.

workflow:generation.cancel.scope: Alphy supports a cancelled terminal generation request with session checks before persistence. This status covers cancellation only.

workflow:refine.state.scope: Alphy preserves all existing fields, types, collection definitions, and IDs. It rejects destructive revisions rather than applying reference reset behavior.

workflow:repair.edits.scope: Alphy retries invalid generated output once with structured validation feedback. It does not apply source edits or smoke-run every handler.

workflow:build.preview.scope: Alphy validates schema, typed state, native UI, and a safe preview. It does not compile VERA or smoke-run every handler.

native_capabilities.arguments: {}; system camera thumbnail, user reviews before keeping

verification_criteria.ui: Create and reopen an artifact for each declared component. Verify declared props, allowed styles, child rules, visible output, typed events, and state preservation.
verification_criteria.graphics: Render each operation with deterministic coordinates and colors. Compare a saved image and helper outputs. Verify shape limits, transforms, and pointer phases.
verification_criteria.sdk: Invoke the exact binding with documented valid and invalid params. Verify typed results, permission denial, unsupported hardware, and explicit failures. Never equate request acceptance with physical success.
verification_criteria.calendar: Use a disposable selected calendar. Verify exact filters, IDs, time zones, recurrence, DTO fields, create/update/delete results, permission denial, cancellation, and retained unrelated data.
verification_criteria.live: Replay fixed search hits and extraction replies. Verify figure provenance, labels, limits, expiry, missing configuration, and explicit errors without live model calls.
verification_criteria.intent: Verify address, presence, mode, parameter schema, permission result, ignored-target filtering, and actual visible effect. Return codes alone do not prove the requested effect.
verification_criteria.intent_candidate: Resolve only through a supplied live-registry snapshot. Missing module, ability, or presence must keep the candidate uncallable.
verification_criteria.intent_summary: Treat every summary as metadata. Require an independent target contract before a capability claim.
verification_criteria.intent_registry: Use a fixed registry snapshot. Verify empty-registry behavior, full addresses, and last-entry selection for duplicate bundle/intent lookup keys.
verification_criteria.workflow: Use the per-entry deterministic workflow criteria. Save revision, command, inputs, and expected/observed results.
verification_criteria.ui_helper: Verify conditional visibility and formatting for zero, negative values, finite bounds, dates, times, and durations. Compare exact expected labels.

workflows.behavior: Surface route, agent composition, then whole-screen hole; explicit not-built or cancelled outcome.
workflows.verification: Use deterministic host replies for each route; verify route order and terminal outcomes.

workflows.behavior: Convert the request to needs and select finite ready parts or sections.
workflows.verification: Replay a fixed needs response; verify every required need has a selected part or explicit unresolved hole.

workflows.behavior: Match unresolved needs to catalog sections before custom source.
workflows.verification: Replay a section selection; verify matched needs disappear from the custom remainder.

workflows.behavior: Assemble selected parts, section bindings, state, handlers, and the complete screen.
workflows.verification: Assemble a fixed multi-part request; verify handlers and shared state through complete actions.

workflows.behavior: Generate the unresolved section against the screen plan and available SDK/intent contracts.
workflows.verification: Supply a fixed section response; validate its inputs, outputs, bindings, and final assembled behavior.

workflows.behavior: Generate a complete ui.Surface app; compile and play it; at most two source attempts.
workflows.verification: Replay a drawing or game with pointer events; verify visible state and bounded failure.

workflows.behavior: Compile and smoke-run the assembled source before service; repair bounded failures.
workflows.verification: Reject invalid source and failed handlers; serve only a source that passes every required smoke action.

workflows.behavior: Run init, view, and every handler with bounded typed sample payloads.
workflows.verification: Use a fixed artifact with a failing action; verify that the action failure blocks service.

workflows.behavior: Apply at most two repair rounds to current source; compile and smoke-run after each accepted edit.
workflows.verification: Replay valid, ambiguous, missing, and still-invalid edits; verify bounded retries and retained diagnostics.

workflows.behavior: Apply replacement edits with source anchors; report invalid edits.
workflows.verification: Verify exact matching, ambiguous anchors, missing anchors, and complete-source replies against fixed source.

workflows.behavior: Select a composition edit, modify a section graph, and rebuild its source.
workflows.verification: Add, remove, replace, and move a section; verify unaffected sections and state remain usable.

workflows.behavior: Carry compatible fields and arrays; fresh defaults replace incompatible or removed reference fields.
workflows.verification: Verify compatible field and record retention. Alphy must reject destructive schema changes under project instructions.

workflows.behavior: Search the offline SDK index with an optional implemented-target filter.
workflows.verification: Search fixed requests; verify exact target, contract, and implemented/stub distinction.

workflows.behavior: Build curated, installed Celia, and raw-registry candidates; exclude ignored and unreachable targets.
workflows.verification: Use a fixed registry; verify provenance, exact addresses, precedence, filtering, and no invented ability names.

workflows.behavior: Return a cancelled terminal outcome when the generation host reports cancellation.
workflows.verification: Cancel a request before generation and before draft commit; verify no accepted tool appears.
